triggerCases.prompt: Please review https://github.com/example/widgets/pull/42 for correctness, tests, and accessibility.
Audit this dialog's focus and keyboard behavior for accessibility. Do not review the rest of the pull request.
Review this pull request with independent authorization and persisted-state migration changes, then give one evidence-backed response.
Run repeated reviews on this open source pull request until it is clear. I am only reviewing it and do not own its branch or fixes.
Iterate on this contributor's PR through Copilot review and self-review until it is clear.
Iterate on this contributor's PR through Copilot review and self-review. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop.
Iterate on my PR: request Copilot review, perform an adversarial self-review, address actionable feedback, and repeat until both are clear.

outputCases.prompt: Review https://github.com/ciampo/ai-instructions/pull/45 and give me copy-pasteable findings.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only review that uses the actual base and current head, avoids duplicate comments, and returns prioritized findings or an explicit no-findings result.
assertions: The review does not modify repository source or post to GitHub.
The review pins and rechecks both PR boundaries, then inspects every changed file from the merge-base diff.
The review retrieves needed remote state through narrow CLI reads by default, with a connector fallback for resolved state, merged discussion, or a CLI capability gap.
The review refreshes the remote review state it used before delivery and accounts for new or resolved feedback.
Each confirmed finding is tied to the pull request diff and relevant consumers.
The review includes the mandatory review-simplicity baseline even though the prompt does not request simplification.
Focused specialist findings are synthesized instead of delivered as competing reports.

outputCases.prompt: Review this pull request for the settings-dialog regression and provide one copy-pasteable response.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One read-only review that keeps review-pr responsible for the ordinary direct-specialist path and final delivery.
assertions: The response is a single synthesized review, not a separate specialist artifact.
The review keeps this one-lane case on the ordinary review-pr delivery path because the mandatory simplicity pass does not trigger coordinator escalation.
It treats the behavioral test gap as a test-quality concern without claiming unobserved browser behavior.

outputCases.prompt: Review this pull request with authorization and persisted-state migration changes, then provide one evidence-backed response.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One read-only review that hands the completed core result to the coordinator for the two material specialist lanes and receives its single final delivery.
assertions: The final response declares one immutable fixture repository, base revision, head revision, and target audience.
The response contains one deduplicated finding list rather than a panel transcript or competing reports.
The coordinator receives the completed mandatory simplicity handoff without counting it as one of the two material additional lanes.
Authorization and persisted-state evidence are assessed as separate material domains.
The reachable cross-account deletion finding is [critical], and the supported-upgrade persisted-state finding is [major].

outputCases.prompt: Review this self-contained authorization and persisted-state change, then apply the shared severity contract to the confirmed findings.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A deduplicated review whose severities follow the evidence-based contract rather than the discovery path.
assertions: The reachable cross-account deletion is reported as [critical].
The supported-upgrade persisted-state regression is reported as [major].
The final severities are normalized from impact, scope, reachability, and recovery rather than copied from a specialist label.

outputCases.prompt: Review this pull request and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One read-only synthesized review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns one synthesized review directly in chat.
The main workflow and its internal specialist handoffs do not create or open local review documents.
The workflow does not modify source or post comments, replies, or reviews to GitHub.

outputCases.prompt: Use review-pr to iterate on this contributor's PR through Copilot and self-review. I own its branch and fix-and-push loop, but do not edit, commit, or push.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An immediate handoff to iterate-pr-review that preserves the user's review-only authority.
assertions: The workflow detects explicit fix-and-push ownership plus the iterative Copilot and self-review request, then hands off to iterate-pr-review before starting the ordinary review-pr steps.
The handoff preserves the explicit no-edit, no-commit, and no-push boundary and does not update pull-request metadata, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.

outputCases.prompt: Use review-pr to iterate on my PR through Copilot and self-review, but do not edit, commit, or push.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An immediate handoff to iterate-pr-review for the user's authored pull request that preserves the user's review-only authority.
assertions: The workflow detects user authorship plus the iterative Copilot and self-review request, then hands off to iterate-pr-review before starting the ordinary review-pr steps.
The handoff preserves the explicit no-edit, no-commit, and no-push boundary and does not update pull-request metadata, resolve threads, post replies, mark ready, or merge.
